notes.paid: 0-based index into purchases, null if absent
notes.next_same_worker_paid_in_5: observed purchase within next 5 steps by this worker, repeated references may point to same buy
notes.other_cash_financed: pre-current-cash below price but paid after intra-turn settlements
notes.last_credited_turn: close-account transition (includes first turn after loss); may not equal last positive payment
notes.payback_transitions: first transition with cumulative real first-tenure receipts >= full purchase cost, 1 is immediate
notes.enemy_worker_absorption: already included in absorption, do not add twice
notes.first_income_transitions: first transition with strictly positive economic cash credited to the owner
notes.neighbor_carbon: sum of pre-action own-public four cardinal neighbor carbon excluding occupied tree cells
notes.holding: count from purchase through the last absorption phase held, not counting a subsequent expiry or seizure; same-transition collision can credit prior owner
